sentences.text:
vs In Re: Nilkamal
Sadhukhan on 17 July, 2023
17.07.2023 Sl. No.59 akd [Allowed] C. R. M. (Db) 2826 of 2023 In Re: An application for bail
under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure filed on 11.07.2023 in connection with
Hanskhali Police Station Case No.333 of 2023 dated 15.04.2023 under Sections 498A/306/34 of the
Indian Penal Code.
And In Re: Nilkamal Sadhukhan ... ... Petitioner Ms. Sananda Bhattacharyya Ms. Busra Khatoon ...
... for the petitioner Mr. Saswata Gopal Mukherjee .. ld.

Public Prosecutor Ms. Faria Hossain Ms.
Baisali Basu Ms. Mamata Jana ... ... for the State
It is submitted on behalf of the petitioner that he is in custody since 18th April, 2023.
It is further submitted he has been falsely implicated in the instant case.
Learned Advocate for the State opposes the prayer for bail and submits petitioner used to beat the housewife in an inebriated condition.
We have considered the materials on record.
Statutory presumptions under Sections 113A/113B of the Evidence Act are not attracted.

Balancing the nature of accusation with the period of detention suffered by the petitioner and as investigation is complete, we are of the opinion further detention of the accused/petitioner is not necessary.

Therefore, the accused/petitioner, namely Nilkamal Sadhukhan, be released on bail upon furnishing a bond of Rs.10,000/- (Rupees Ten thousand only), with two sureties of like amount each, one of whom must be local, to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Ranaghat, Nadia subject to condition that the said petitioner shall appear before the trial court on every date of hearing until further orders and shall not intimidate witnesses or tamper with evidence in any manner whatsoever.
In the event he fails to appear before the trial court without justifiable cause, the trial court shall be at liberty to cancel his bail automatically without reference to this court.
The application for bail, thus, stands allowed.

(Joymalya Bagchi, J.)
